## Findings carried into the plan

- GitHub Project membership is not exhaustive contribution scope. Preserve eligible unboarded repository activity.
- Merged research PRs included duplicate commit appearances and intermediate-branch merges. Separate PR activity from unique default-branch integration.
- Public source actor fields do not establish whether work was manual or AI assisted.
- Research acceptance, app implementation, public deployment and contribution recognition are different states.
- Optional Discussions support requires an enabled source; unavailable features are not zero contributions.

The organization Project count and membership above precede this delivery Project. The leaderboard repository and future additions require explicit onboarding by stable repository/Project IDs. Recheck source access, pagination, event availability and organization membership before ingestion and before any public metric is enabled.

## Evidence publication boundary

[The sanitized manifest](../planning/source-audit.json) retains source URLs, reviewed revisions, aggregate inventory and limitations. [API evidence](../planning/metric-api-evidence.json) retains official references and capability interpretations. Raw GitHub exports, full consultation sessions, private local paths, credentials and personal/customer datasets are not part of this repository.

The UI consultation is attributed to the actual observed model in [the UI concept](../planning/ui/ui-concept.json). Its reviewed requirements are mapped to the canonical work packages, not treated as proof of implemented behavior.

## Research integration

Follow the [research workflow](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-research/blob/main/docs/RESEARCH_WORKFLOW.md) for the meaning of accepted research. Catalog proposals, pricebooks and compatibility review belong to the research repository. The leaderboard records evidence about those contributions without modifying the imported v1 contract or inventing acceptance. Preserve live assignees and source decision-record paths.
